quarterly_data.quarter: Roche-Genentech press release: Roche presents new data at EURETINA, highlighting Vabysmo's (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Roche presented new data at EURETINA 2026 from VOYAGER, a prospective non-interventional real-world study of Vabysmo (faricimab) with more than 5,000 patients enrolled (company: the largest such dataset), in nAMD, DME and RVO; results were in line with Phase III, with no new safety signals. Mean visual acuity change in previously untreated eyes: +4.6 ETDRS letters in nAMD and +8.2 in DME after 12 months, +10.0 in branch RVO and +16.6 in central/hemi-RVO after 6 months (CST -110.5, -127.8, -171.3 and -287.4 µm); previously treated eyes were stable or improved (-0.1, +2.7, +2.0 and +3.9 letters). In nAMD and DME, fewer injections were given in months 7-12 than in months 1-6, suggesting interval extension. AI-enabled imaging analysis confirmed rapid anatomical drying.
quarterly_data.figure: VOYAGER >5,000 patients; untreated eyes VA +4.6 (nAMD), +8.2 (DME), +10.0 (BRVO), +16.6 (CRVO/HRVO) letters
